name: Winning Souls For Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that winning souls for Christ is both a wise and vital calling, described as bearing fruit like a tree of life (Proverbs 11:30). Believers are commissioned to actively proclaim the gospel to all nations and creatures, making disciples and baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19; Mark 16:15). This responsibility is underscored by the prophetic role of warning others to turn from sin, with serious consequences for neglecting this duty (Ezekiel 3:17, 20). Faith and baptism are essential for salvation, highlighting the eternal significance of leading others to Christ (Mark 16:16).
